proof: Default-off preserves independent studies. Mode-only restores each target own input/cut; unprepared targets fail visibly, never auto-copy source input.

Mode and cursor together enter four separately captured 1m/5m studies at one absolute UTC cut. Actual controlled OHLCV/SMA20 agree with independent per-input reference before and after complete restart.
Real peer PATCH commits while its response is held: target shows restoring-study and zero bars before acknowledgement. No substituted response bodies.
A successful cursor operation cannot hide unconfirmed mode. Concurrent group routing changes preserve a visible source retry; actual retry works above the live loading overlay.
Open note editor refuses mode exit and keeps its own cursor. Closing editor and clicking the live-source retry recovers all targets.
Real source exit PATCH commits and its response aborts; real authoritative GET is held. Source stays masked, peers keep prior modes; releasing GET recovers committed exit across both windows.
Original account-note versions and future hiding remain correct. Final fixture counts remain accounts=2, orders=0, fills=0, cash_flows=0, journal_entries=5, journal_revisions=6.
Complete owned quit/restart keeps inactive saved inputs, group options and cursors; explicit resume follows the saved cut rather than wall time. Exactly one saved input per owner; no renderer errors.
